ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Funding Freezes
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's funding freezes, including the Gateway Tunnel Project and other projects that have been affected.
questions: What are the motivations behind the Trump administration's funding freezes?
How have the funding freezes affected the affected projects?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing by the Trump administration and highlight the impact of their funding freezes on various projects and programs.
